title: Update homepage hero image and apply colorful handprints background

requirements.text: Add the uploaded “Cool Kidz Club” image as a static frontend asset and use it as the hero image on the Clubhouse home page (replacing the current hero image).

quotes: Use the cool kids club as the homepage hero image

acceptanceCriteria: The homepage hero image on the Clubhouse home page displays the new “Cool Kidz Club” artwork instead of the current /assets/generated/clubhouse-hero-sunny-park.dim_1600x900.png image.
The hero image is loaded from a static file in the frontend (not via backend).
The hero image remains responsive and does not overflow its rounded container.

requirements.text: Add the uploaded “colorful handprints” image as a static frontend asset and apply it as the background across the app (at least for the main app shell/pages), ensuring foreground content remains readable.

quotes: make the colorful handprints the backgrounds

acceptanceCriteria: All primary pages (Home, Parent Portal, Tours) show the colorful handprints background behind the main content.
Text, buttons, and BubbleCard content maintain good readability over the background (e.g., via opacity/overlay or other styling adjustments).
Background rendering performs well (no obvious jank) and scales appropriately on mobile and desktop.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).

Do not modify any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Keep backend behavior unchanged; this request is frontend-only asset/styling changes.
nonGoals: Do not change routing, navigation labels, or page copy beyond what is necessary to place the new images.
Do not implement new backend endpoints or data models for image delivery.
Do not remove or redesign existing sticker/decoration systems (stars/butterflies) unless required for readability with the new background.

edits: Convert and crop the uploaded Cool Kidz Club artwork for a wide hero format (629b7279fe312b0b9b003637c585582c.jpeg > cool-kidz-club-hero.dim_1600x900.jpg)

Create a background-ready version of the colorful handprints (crop/clean as needed and make it suitable for repeating/cover) (e3f87be54e3bc03ffd5c0ec55ecb5542.jpeg > colorful-handprints-bg.dim_2048x2048.png)
